scope: Metadata/allocated sizes only for checkpoints, main and validation project/dependency generated build roots, and validation fresh-check-* private roots. No payload/archive reads or hashes, compiler, process inspection, signals, cache/source changes or deletion. Existing small evidence JSON records were read for comparisons.
observation_limits: Non-atomic: fresh2 remains active and filesystem allocation can change while the census runs. Negative deltas/inode identity changes do not identify a writer. Selected-root totals do not cover the whole filesystem; no full-build peak or growth-rate forecast is inferred. Root-inode/canonical separation is not a proof of absence of cross-tree links or active references. Allocated sums count paths and can overcount hard links; such links are counted explicitly.

concrete_added_allocations_since_preflig.limitation: The preflight found no fresh-check-* roots. Checkpoint028/029 verification records date after that preflight. These observed additions do not balance or attribute the whole filesystem free-space movement; other selected roots lack a simultaneous earlier baseline, and locations outside the requested scope were not inspected.

smallest_useful_next_capacity_option.recommendation: If more headroom is needed, first verify and consider one one-time retirement of the oldest local source checkpoint025 copy, preserving its durable upload and the later local checkpoints. Checkpoint026 offers a second similarly sized option only if needed. Neither retirement is performed or authorised by this assessment.
smallest_useful_next_capacity_option.remaining_checks: Root must confirm no earlier retirement disposition forbids reuse, recheck the exact current file identity/payload SHA/upload receipt/Library binding as required by the existing retirement workflow, and explicitly choose the single action. This metadata-only assessment did not rehash payloads or recheck Library attributes.

excluded_cleanup_candidates.active_validation_outputs: Preserve all validation dependency, ordinary project and current private fresh outputs. This assessment does not authorize altering active inputs or retained integrity evidence.
excluded_cleanup_candidates.previously_retired_main_roots: Returned Mathlib/Aesop/Batteries roots were observed at distinct identities from their originally retired roots. Do not automatically or repeatedly delete them. Returned main Mathlib currently allocates only 51,875,840 bytes, so it is not a multi-gigabyte capacity option in this census.
excluded_cleanup_candidates.other_main_generated_roots: The never-retired-looking main project plus Qq/proofwidgets/importGraph/LeanSearchClient/plausible cohorts total only 105,476,096 bytes. Their canonical/root inode separation and observed single-link regular files do not substitute for an active-reference/ownership assessment; a single verified older source archive offers more capacity with less cache disruption.
excluded_cleanup_candidates.old_checkpoint_and_temporary_files: Do not automatically remove returned checkpoint000 or the old bootstrap temporary files. Their presence does not establish a current writer or supply a fresh cleanup authorisation.

assessment.fit_and_causality_limits: The observed root-free space exceeds the existing launch floor, while nonreserved available space is substantially smaller. This census does not establish the complete fresh-build peak plus future checkpoint operations, predict a growth rate, explain the nonmonotonic free-space series, identify a writer, or establish a new formal integrity incident. No emergency cleanup or threshold reduction follows solely from this sample.
assessment.mutations: Only this assessment JSON is created; recorder repositories remain frozen. No compiler/hash helper, process inspection/signals, payload hashes, cleanup, or source/cache changes.
